title: Game sounds
doc: Numbered list of built-in game sounds; the game refers to them by their position, so rows must not be added, removed or reordered.

sections.name: #Sounds Start
sections.doc: One row per sound, read until #Sounds End; there are no field markers.

columns.doc: distance at which a 3D sound starts to fade
rolloff factor; below 1 fades sooner, above 1 later
